news.title: UW–Madison and Green Bay-area partners build flood resilience along the East River
news.summary_en: With coordinating support from UW’s Wisconsin Sea Grant, the East River Collaborative brings together The Nature Conservancy, NEW Water and local governments to build a more resilient East River watershed.

news.title: Incarceration rates are declining. A new study explores some of the reasons why.
news.summary_en: A new analysis of data highlights the extent of declines and shows the reasons prison populations are shrinking differ from the reasons incarceration grew.

news.title: Summer sweet spots
news.summary_en: Across campus and around Madison, summer brings people together in the places that define the season, from beloved UW traditions and Camp Randall concerts to neighborhoods where community takes root.
